description_en: Queries the list of agent versions
kebab_example: aliyun agentcore list-agent-versions --workspace-id ws-0123456789abcdef01234 --agent-id agent-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListAgentVersions

parameters.help_en: The ID of the AgentCore workspace where the agent resides
parameters.help_zh: 智能体所在的 AgentCore 工作空间 ID
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the managed or custom agent
parameters.help_zh: 托管智能体或自定义智能体 ID
parameters.name: agent_id

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of records per page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 单页最大记录数，取值范围 1 至 100，默认 20
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token returned in the previous ListAgentVersions response when you query the next page. Do not specify this parameter for the first query
parameters.help_zh: 查询下一页时传入上一次 ListAgentVersions 响应返回的 nextToken；首次查询不传
parameters.name: next_token

code.description_en: The business status code. The value is SUCCESS if the request is successful, or an error code if the request fails
code.description_zh: 业务状态码，请求成功时为 SUCCESS，失败时为错误码

items.description_en: The list of fixed versions on the current page, sorted in descending order of creation time. The configuration is not included
items.description_zh: 当前页的固定版本列表，按创建时间倒序排列，不包含 configuration

agentId.description_en: The ID of the managed or custom agent to which the version belongs
agentId.description_zh: 版本所属的托管智能体或自定义智能体 ID

agentVersion.description_en: The version number generated by the system in ascending order for the agent, such as v1 and v2. It is used when querying, deleting, and referencing versions in service endpoints
agentVersion.description_zh: 系统按 Agent 递增生成的版本号，例如 v1、v2。查询、删除版本及服务端点引用版本时使用

artifactStatus.description_en: Indicates only whether the version template and artifact archiving are complete, and does not represent the deployment or running status. READY indicates complete. INVALID indicates that the archive is missing or inconsistent
artifactStatus.description_zh: 仅表示版本模板与制品归档是否完整，不代表部署或运行状态。READY 为完整，INVALID 为归档缺失或不一致

createdAt.description_en: The time when the version was saved, in ISO 8601 UTC format
createdAt.description_zh: 版本保存的时间，采用 ISO 8601 UTC 格式
createdAt.title_en: 版本创建时间，采用 ISO 8601 UTC 格式
createdAt.title_zh: 版本创建时间，采用 ISO 8601 UTC 格式

createdBy.description_en: The UID of the Alibaba Cloud account of the caller who saved the version. If the API is called by a RAM user, this value is the UID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the RAM user belongs
createdBy.description_zh: 保存该版本的调用者阿里云账号 UID；RAM 用户调用时为其所属阿里云主账号 UID

description.description_en: The version description entered when the version is saved. It can be up to 1,024 characters in length. If no description is entered when the version is saved, this value is empty
description.description_zh: 保存版本时填写的版本描述，最多 1024 个字符；保存时未填写则为空

targetSpecVersion.description_en: The effective release serial number of the agent when the version is saved, which is the effectiveSpecVersion at that time. This value does not change after the version is saved
targetSpecVersion.description_zh: 保存版本时 Agent 已生效的发布流水号，即当时的 effectiveSpecVersion。版本保存后该值不再变化
targetSpecVersion.title_en: 保存时固化的 Agent 发布流水号，即保存时的 effectiveSpecVersion
targetSpecVersion.title_zh: 保存时固化的 Agent 发布流水号，即保存时的 effectiveSpecVersion

versionName.description_en: The display name specified by the user when the version is saved. For earlier saved versions that do not have a recorded name, the agentVersion is returned
versionName.description_zh: 保存版本时用户指定的展示名称。早期保存且未记录名称的版本返回 agentVersion

workspaceId.description_en: The ID of the AgentCore workspace where the agent to which the version belongs resides
workspaceId.description_zh: 版本所属智能体所在的 AgentCore 工作空间 ID

maxResults.description_en: The maximum number of records per page used in this query
maxResults.description_zh: 本次查询使用的单页最大记录数
maxResults.title_en: 本次查询使用的单页最大记录数
maxResults.title_zh: 本次查询使用的单页最大记录数

message.description_en: The response message. The value is success if the request is successful, or an error message if the request fails
message.description_zh: 响应消息，请求成功时为 success，失败时为错误信息

nextToken.description_en: The pagination token for the next page. Pass this value as the nextToken request parameter when you query the next page. An empty value indicates that no more data is available
nextToken.description_zh: 下一页的分页令牌，查询下一页时作为请求参数 nextToken 传入；为空表示没有更多数据

requestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used to locate and troubleshoot the request
requestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于定位和排查请求
requestId.title_en: 请求 ID，用于定位和排查请求
requestId.title_zh: 请求 ID，用于定位和排查请求

success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful

totalCount.description_en: The total number of undeleted fixed versions of the agent, excluding the system-maintained latest version
totalCount.description_zh: 该智能体未删除的固定版本总数，不包含系统维护的 latest 版本
